version_scope: School-labeled 2014 aerial exterior; 2025-10 floor plans used only for relative topology crosscheck
coordinate_policy: Model X is paper right; Y is paper down; Z is up. Not geographical directions.
dimension_status: All output millimetres are model-relative estimates; no real-world height, floor height or 1:N scale is claimed
detail_level: Coarsened observed exterior with explicitly simplified hidden closures
print_status: Not physically test printed; large portico/gallery/roof spans require support evaluation
hidden_facade_policy: Two rear diagonal faces are neutral low-detail closures, not a claim of windowless as-built walls; no mirrored windows
roof_policy: Segmented central panels and large open side frames; no whole triangular solid pyramid or complete tenth storey

fabrication_simplifications.rounded_plan_corners: Original 2D unions rounded before extrusion, clipped entrance and guard ends rounded after clipping
fabrication_simplifications.facades: Observed paper-right entrance/main/tail groups with pale sills; obscured paper-left fewer conservative openings; counts estimated
fabrication_simplifications.roof_interior: Unverified interior/print closure confined to front and central roof-panel plan projections, bottom at model deck87; not actual auditorium reconstruction
fabrication_simplifications.roof_gaps: Large side voids and high gap at model y141–145 retained; no connecting bars across this gap
fabrication_simplifications.panel_edge_frames: Rounded integral beam width2.8mm with center1.4mm below panel upper edge; top caps aligned
fabrication_simplifications.local_joints: Two nominal9x4x4mm rounded connection collars at y134; no continuous side wall
fabrication_simplifications.ridge_support: 3mm wide central capsule support with centers y159/164; unverified interior support estimate
